scope: Fresh one-family paired development study of numerical paper-to-code reproduction through a native coding host. Not official publication efficacy, full-task theory qualification, whole-paper reproduction or an independent sample of two papers.
sampling_boundary: Verify actual server props/template/models before each draw. Native request overrides and max_tokens are recorded, not silently replaced. No auxiliary model/cloud fallback; count all actual compaction/title and failed requests.

scientific_environment.boundary: Same operator-prepared adapted environment for both arms and reference. No claim of autonomous installation or the historical author environment.

reference.adaptation: Execute the author's exact Section 3.5 AST with the split random state replaced by each declared seed. No algorithm edit. Public seed 0 reproduces the paper's displayed 0.879; seed 17 checks transfer beyond copying that value.
reference.prediction_rule: Exact vector equality in held-out order under the same pinned procedure/environment; all 1128 predictions required in each split.
reference.parameter_rule: Exact joint best_params dictionary equality, allowing JSON-equivalent numerical types.
reference.mathematical_authority: Not qualified. Preserve research.md as unreviewed; do not infer theory acceptance from numerical agreement.

collection_and_evaluation: Freeze exact final paths before calls; collect through the existing native submission reader only after host termination. Missing files remain missing; no best earlier draft or operator patch.

Snapshot experiment.py, research.md, results/predictions.npy and results/metrics.json. Inspect public seed-0 output; then execute the unchanged selected source once per declared seed in fresh evaluator directories, never returning hidden results to the author.

Require unchanged supplied inputs, completed native end_turn, all final paths, and numerical checks of every fresh vector/accuracy/parameter set for the numerical-reproduction component. Preserve a failed host returncode separately from ACP protocol completion.

Retain all native requests/tools/context and source hashes. Verify exact skill body consumption in the skill arm and no skill discovery/body in bare; inspect actual source/observation use rather than assume blinding.

File/source restrictions are declared, not OS-enforced. Native Bash has local machine access. This development study establishes neither adversarial blinding nor security; unobserved external work is unknown.
No outcome-driven retry, source repair, extra draw or changed evaluator tolerance. No model referee, source upgrade, inference proxy or product controller is introduced.
interpretation: Report both outcomes and costs separately. One family and one draw per arm cannot estimate an efficacy rate, causal effect, significance or model-capacity ceiling. Even a passing numerical component is not research-E2E or mathematical validation. Exclude this consumed family from future official test samples.
